# Workflow map

<!-- Generated by .claude/runtime/build-pack-docs.mjs from the pack registries. Do not edit by hand. -->

24 workflows under `.claude/workflows`. A phase marked **approval** waits for a recorded human decision; a high-impact skill must sit in or directly after such a phase.

## brownfield-change

A bounded change (feature/fix) to an existing project. This is the default workflow the systemic-audit skill's Phases 1-15 implement in full; a plain L1-L2 change uses only its early phases (see .claude/rules/00-execution-protocol.md impact levels).

| Phase | Agents | Skills | Gates | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `discovery` | `repo-intelligence` | none | none | none |
| `requirements` | `requirements-analyst` | none | none | `discovery` |
| `impact-classification` | none | none | none | `requirements` |
| `findings-inventory` | `architecture-reviewer`, `backend-reviewer`, `frontend-reviewer`, `security-reviewer` | none | none | `impact-classification` |
| `canonical-decisions` | none | `canonical-naming` | none | `findings-inventory` |
| `cross-layer-impact` | none | `cross-layer-impact` | none | `canonical-decisions` |
| `implementation` | `implementation-engineer` | `evidence-collection` | `incremental` | `cross-layer-impact` |
| `adversarial-review` | `adversarial-reviewer` | none | none | `implementation` |
| `regression` | none | `regression-gates`, `residue-search` | `global` | `adversarial-review` |
| `closure` | `git-auditor` | `release-checkpoint` | `completion` | `regression` |

Recovery: mission-recovery skill; resume from .claude/ops/state.json rather than restarting discovery

Completion: completion-gate.mjs PASS; no undisposed CRITICAL/HIGH finding; git-auditor evidence PASS

## bug-fix

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `reproduce` | `root-cause-investigator`, `runtime-validator` | `root-cause-analysis`, `runtime-path-trace` | none | none |

| `fix` | `implementation-lead` | `fix-bug`, `create-regression-tests` | `incremental` | `diagnose` |
| `regression-review` | `regression-analyzer`, `code-reviewer` | `blast-radius-analysis`, `diff-review` | none | `fix` |
| `verification` | `verification-controller`, `validation-orchestrator` | `run-unit-tests`, `run-integration-tests`, `verify` | `global` | `regression-review` |
| `closure` | `repository-guardian`, `completion-controller` | `definition-of-done` | `completion` | `verification` |

Recovery: recovery workflow when the same failure fingerprint repeats twice; change root-cause strategy

Completion: regression test failed before and passes after; root cause recorded; completion gate PASS
